newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Old Kent EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Old Kent EPS view cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it lowered its earnings estimates for Old Kent Financial Corp to $0.90 a share from $0.93 for the fourth quarter of 1996, and to $3.80 from $3.95 for 1997.
--In a report, EVEREN said it was lowering its estimates because of a higher projected expense base for Old Kent and a slowdown in its share repurchase program.
--It also raised its intermediate six-month price target on the stock to $46 from $43 and long-term 18-month target to $50 from $45.
--Old Kent was up 1 to 46-1/8 near the end of regular Nasdaq trading on Friday.
